system.story: Years in a freelance military outfit; adaptable, gear-savvy, loyal to the contract and the crew, not a flag.

description.value:
Origin: Merc. You cut your teeth in a freelance military outfit. You bring the right tool for the job and swap it mid-fight when the job changes.

Field Arsenal

You may maintain two Kits at once and swap between them as a maneuver mid-fight (a direct nod to the Tactician's two-kit feature, granted here as the Merc's adaptability). You are the most Kit-forward Operator.

Signature tweak

Trigger Cadence costs 1 less Adrenaline the first time each encounter.

Bonus skill & contact

Choose Streetwise or Demolitions, and gain a fixer contact who brings the jobs.

Chrome flavor

Mixed-market, modular chrome - swap-and-tune, pairs with the two-Kit fantasy. (Benchmark numbers; tuned in the numeric pass.)
